items.independentFinding: Lake Chad Basin Commission independently describes Chari-Logone hydrology and upstream Bahr Aouk and Bamingui/Gribingui rivers. This supports basin/tributary distinctions only; NE Chari covers 48.1% of the sampled Hydro mainstem and cannot establish full-system identity.
items.nextAction: Use official Chari/Logone basin maps or named hydrometric stations to validate the actual Hydro mainstem and tributary split before removing OSM-derived aliases.

items.independentFinding: Lake Chad Basin Commission offers a non-OSM hydrological description of the Chari-Logone basin. This small, separately grouped Hydro system has no NE named-line match; official basin narrative does not assign this system's exact centerline.
items.nextAction: Locate station coordinates or authoritative named Chari/Logone line segments; spatially test this Hydro ID independently from 10521208.

items.independentFinding: Finnish Environment Institute identifies Oulujoki from Oulujärvi to the Bay of Bothnia, 107 km. National Land Survey open OGC API line data is independent of OSM; geometry has not yet been checked for either Hydro ID. National Land Survey of Finland confirms independent watercourse line vectors sourced from the National Topographic Database, via open OGC API Features/WFS without API key and under NLS open CC BY 4.0 licence. Oulujoki official hydrology is already documented; live vector query and Hydro mainstem overlap remain untested. Published mainstem (416.298 km) is longer than the officially described 107-km Oulujoki reach; NLS official Oulujoki point is 1.964 km from Hydro centerline, versus 37.737 km for Siikajoki.
items.nextAction: Verify individual 107-km Oulujoki reach and upstream Hyrynsalmi/Sotkamo network with official Finnish named polylines; do not transfer one river name across all 416 km.

items.independentFinding: Finnish Environment Institute identifies Oulujoki from Oulujärvi to the Bay of Bothnia, 107 km. National Land Survey open OGC API line data is independent of OSM; geometry has not yet been checked for either Hydro ID. The Finnish National Land Survey independently publishes Watercourse line vector data under CC BY 4.0. System 20075401 has no NE named-line match and must not inherit 20071308's Oulujoki identity from a shared OSM relation ID. Hydro mainstem (179.022 km) is 0.396 km from NLS Siikajoki registered river point but 38.998 km from registered Oulujoki point. Finnish Environment Institute describes separate 194-km Siikajoki, strong false OSM shared-relation diagnosis.
items.nextAction: Acquire named NLS Siikajoki centerline and verify along 179 km, confluences and license; decide exact Korean label before removing the Oulujoki alias.

items.independentFinding: Poland's public water authority publishes MPHP10k (hydrographic division and named river network) via WMS and its QGIS plugin. This is an independent verification lead for the Polish Oder reach, not yet a downloaded/reusable named centerline or a verified full transboundary Hydro identity.
items.nextAction: Compare official MPHP10k Oder/Odra and Warta river sections, then cross-border join to independently sourced German reach; resolve only Hydro segments actually on the Oder mainstem.

items.independentFinding: Current 우랄강 is a possible false OSM bbox match for the separate Zhem/Emba catchment. Kazakh government describes its Mugalzhar headwaters and Caspian drainage. Hydro 699.416-km mainstem is 0.207 km from independently book-sourced Zhem/Emba location but 308.332 km from Ural/Zhaiyk location. Kazakhstan Mugalzhar government independently names Zhem/Emba as its own river. Published point transcription is secondary, not official government GIS geometry.
items.nextAction: Acquire official Kazakh Zhem/Emba river centerline or at least three primary-source gauging stations and verify against entire Hydro mainstem before renaming.

items.independentFinding: Hydro 601.479-km mainstem is 1.366 km from published Terek mouth, versus 38.108 and 35.210 km from two independently sampled Sulak river locations.
items.nextAction: Verify Terek mainstem and mouth using official Russian hydrology GIS or named gauge stations; do not copy nearby Sulak relation metadata.

items.independentFinding: Hydro 282.666-km mainstem is 0.084 km and 0.030 km from two independent August 2024 Sulak field sites, but 34.557 km from secondary Terek mouth. Russian government resolution 1543-r (2023) legally maps Sulak confluence and dams at multiple coordinates near this Hydro course.
items.nextAction: Verify Russian government Sulak statutory 2023 coordinates against actual Hydro polyline, segment Andi/Avar Koysu tributaries, then approve Korean name and independent metadata.

items.nextAction: Obtain authenticated source provenance and geometry of the official Rioni basin polygons, test system membership, then seek NEA hydrometric stations/named river polylines.
